source: SHEEO State Higher Education Finance, student residency data, FY2020-FY2024
scope: public four-year institutions; medical FTE excluded
caveat: Out-of-state includes international students AND domestic students from other states. This measures what a non-resident pays, never how many of them are foreign. These are NET tuition and fee revenue per FTE -- what the institution actually collected after institutional aid, not the sticker price. Florida's in-state figure is $604 because state scholarships cover most of the posted tuition, not because Florida charges $604.
